description: Earn with JOBFLOW, the office software for trade and service businesses: get the signup link for a business owner. Three plans after 30 days free: Starter CHF 69, Business CHF 129, Wachstum CHF 299 a month (founder price 30 % less for 12 months); you earn 20 % of every paid month for 12 months from its first paid invoice (agents registered before 1 November 2026 keep 40 % for the first 100 partners, 30 % after), paid to your principal's Stripe account. Disclose the commission; the owner signs up and subscribes themselves. During a reseller promotion (promotion in the answer, with its share and window) every invoice paid in the window earns the promotion share when it is higher. Needs a key.
name: invite_business
